title: Arca/arca_cli: migrate scripts/, config's downstream
objective:
Migrate Arca/arca_cli (`~/Devel/prj/Arca/arca_cli`, elixir) off its `scripts/` directory onto devbin, strictly after WP-02: its mix.exs carries `{:arca_config, github: ..., branch: "main", override: true}`, so config must be settled upstream before cli's `deps.update` pulls it.

**Titled "fresh install" until close.** The survey row said fresh install, design.md had already counted arca_cli among the four `scripts/` projects, and the two were never reconciled -- so the WP was reclassified at WP start (ACs extended before code) but its title and objective went on saying the wrong thing for the whole WP. Corrected at close. The same staleness is in WP-08's brief and is to be fixed there BEFORE it starts, not after.
body:
## Deliverables

- Fence, one install commit, doctor green, `help --why` accounted
- Baseline -> `mix deps.update --all` -> green, with the refreshed arca_config ref noted from mix.lock
- Public-API guard as WP-02 (also a published library)
- `config.yaml` + authored help in their own commits

## Dependencies

- WP-02 (arca_config settled upstream first)
- ~~Downstream note: WP-01 Multiplyer branch-deps on THIS project too, so WP-01 waits on this one landing.~~ **Stale from 2026-08-10: WP-01 is cancelled, Multiplyer is EOL. Nothing downstream waits on this WP now.** The conclusion is unchanged -- WP-03 still runs after WP-02, because arca_config is genuinely its upstream -- but the second half of the argument no longer applies.
- ~~**BLOCKED, and hv owns the unblock**: AC-03.2 needs the `arca_config` GitHub dep to resolve to post-WP-02 upstream, and all ten WP-02 commits are unpushed.~~ **Cleared 2026-08-10**: hv pushed and ran `mix deps.update --all`. The lock pins `f3d91c8`, the same commit as arca_config `upstream/main`. AC-03.2 and AC-03.3 both satisfied; arca_cli `69510ca`.
- ~~**Remaining**: AC-03.6 only -- the `scripts/` deletion, which waits on hv's explicit go.~~ **Done 2026-08-10** on hv's go: arca_cli `b470476`. All six ACs satisfied.
